title: Parseval's identity for Boolean functions
statement:
Let $f : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$ be a Boolean function. Then the sum of the squared Fourier--Walsh coefficients of $f$ over all subsets $S \subseteq [n]$ equals the expectation of $f^2$ under the uniform measure:
\[
  \sum_{S \subseteq [n]} \hat f(S)^2 \;=\; \E\!\left[f^2\right].
\]
hypotheses_covered: f is a Boolean function of arity n
